verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a file-conversion service, so archive handling is a fair axis to judge. The evidence never mentions ZIP, 7z, or RAR extraction or repacking. The listed format categories (documents, videos, images, audio, CAD, eBooks) do not include archives. The vague 'Now supporting Compression' banner may refer to file-size compression rather than archive extract/repack, so it does not count as support.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion
